Start, stop and play stop failing in silence, and the build says which build it is.

## 🐞 Fixed

- **Two more swallowed failures in the instance view.** `toggleHalted` had a `try/finally` and no `catch`: the `finally` cleared the spinner and the rejection went nowhere, so a queue call the instance refused looked exactly like a button that was not wired up. The collector's play badge ended in `.catch(() => {})` and switched tabs regardless, so a refused start left you looking at a Downloads tab that had not gained the package the collector appeared to have lost. Both now write one line under the queue bar, in the fail colour, the same line the overview already carries — and the tab only switches once the start actually took.

## 🔢 Changed

- **1.8.1, so an installed build can be told apart from the one on disk.** 1.8.0 shipped twice with very different contents, and "does the app have the collector tab" had no answer you could read off the screen. Every release from here gets its own number even when the change is small.
